entities.summary: Caroline Sara Dubois is a British professional boxer. She has held the WBC female lightweight title since December 2024 and previously was the IBO champion in the same weight division. As an amateur Dubois was Youth Olympic champion, World Youth champion and four-times European Youth champion. She is the younger sister of former heavyweight boxing world champion Daniel Dubois.
